lines.say: A shop in your city buys days from your life. Five hundred dollars each.
You sell a Monday. You close your eyes. It is Tuesday. Five hundred dollars richer.
So you sell more Mondays. Then rainy days. Then your birthday.
You go to see who buys them. An old man at the counter. He has your face.
He is buying them back. Five thousand each. He says he wants Mondays now.
Would you sell a Monday? Write it in the comments.
